facts.label: Algo para beber
facts.sub: Use something em ofertas, anything em perguntas e nothing para dizer nada: Would you like something to drink? Is there anything cold? I have nothing hot.

facts.label: Algo
facts.sub: Use something em ofertas e pedidos: Would you like something to drink? e I’d like something small. Quando você espera um sim, something soa mais natural do que anything. Combine com um adjetivo: something cold, something sweet.

facts.label: Qualquer coisa
facts.sub: Use anything em perguntas e negativas: Is there anything to eat? e I don’t have anything. Ele pergunta se existe algo. Depois de anything, coloque o adjetivo: anything cold, anything hot.
